quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare press release: More than 10 Million Developers Are Building on Cloudflare (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: More than 10 million developers are building on Cloudflare, up from 7.4 million in the prior quarter; daily requests from AI agents on its network grew by more than 1,700% over one year, and this year for the first time more than half of Internet traffic was not human. Cloudflare's network spans more than 340 cities in more than 130 countries, connects with 13,888 networks and has 590 Tbps of external network capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 10 million developers (7.4 million prior quarter); AI-agent daily requests up more than 1,700% in a year; 590 Tbps
